INSERT INTO workspace_diff (source_workspace_id, fork_workspace_id, path, kind, ahead, behind, has_changes, source_last_event_kind, source_last_event_origin)
            SELECT $1, unnest($2::varchar[]), $3, $4, 0, 1, NULL, $5, $6
            ON CONFLICT (source_workspace_id, fork_workspace_id, path, kind)
            DO UPDATE SET
                behind = workspace_diff.behind + 1,
                has_changes = NULL,
                source_last_event_kind = CASE WHEN $6::varchar IS NULL THEN workspace_diff.source_last_event_kind ELSE $5 END,
                source_last_event_origin = COALESCE($6, workspace_diff.source_last_event_origin)
